The first paid step after that is RUB 360 per month (RUB 0.58 per hour) for 1 GB RAM, 1 core, 20 GB SSD and unlimited traffic. Above the 250 GB allowance the page states traffic is charged at RUB 1 per GB. The largest row is RUB 23,040 per month for 64 GB RAM, 8 cores and 400 GB SSD.
